Treatment summary
Patient presented following a rear-end motor vehicle collision with complaints of neck pain and stiffness. The reported
mechanism of injury is consistent with the force and direction of the impact. No prior injury to the cervical region is known from
the patient history. Over five vistis the patient received conservative care including range-of-motion exercises, mnaual therapy,
and home stretching guidance. Symptoms improved steadily, and visit frequency was reduced accordingly as the patient returned
toward baseline function. Cervical imaging and physical examination findings clearly support a diagnosis of cervical strain.
Billing review identified that one service was recorded twice on a single visit date. On inquiry, this office acknowledged the
second entry was a duplicate of the first and has issued a correction. Patient is discharged from active care with instructions to
return if symptoms recur.
